name: Red clay
description: A damp brick of river clay. Potters want it, apothecaries want it, and the Wend has plenty.
notes: Potion ingredient (mw-ju8.4): shop and loot stock only, with no use until a brewing system lands (a later bead). Clay from the river banks, used for seals and bases. Base value 3 sits in the economy ingredient band (3-15).
